notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Barber and beauty services, laundry and dry cleaning, and auto repair labor: not taxed (FTA 2017 survey answer).
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Nevada's 6.85% statewide rate is used as the state rate, following the state's own description of it, but only 2% of it goes to the State General Fund: 2.6% is the Local School Support Tax and 2.25% the city-county relief taxes. County add-ons (to 7.1%-8.375%) are local.
Nevada has no city sales taxes; special tourism districts in the SST file charge the same rate as their county.
